q: Which cycle length is the most common?
What percentage of people had cycles of 27 to 29 days?
A student says "everyone has a 28-day cycle". Use the data to evaluate this.
Wrong: only 42% have 27 to 29 days; 58% are shorter or longer; 21 to 35 days is normal.
Suggest why a survey of 200 people is more reliable than a survey of 10.
A larger sample reduces the effect of unusual individuals, so the pattern is more representative of the population.
